idea-plugin.name: HiveMind Support
idea-plugin.description:
Support for the Apache HiveMind 1.1 dependency injection framework.
  • HiveMind tool window: all services ("beans") of all modules – project and libraries – with interface, implementation, service model and module; filter, sorting, details and navigation
  • Module descriptors (hivemodule.xml and sub-modules): bundled schema for tag/attribute completion and validation
  • Navigation and completion for service, configuration and schema ids (service-id, set-service, configuration-id, <service>, service: object providers …), module ids, sub-module descriptors and class names (relative to the module package)
  • Contributions and factory parameters are interpreted via the translators of their schema (service, configuration, object, instance, class, resource)
  • Find Usages and Rename for service, configuration and schema ids; substitution symbols ${…}, messages %key, interceptor ordering
  • Errors for unknown ids, duplicate service points, multiple overriding implementations, services without implementation, private services used from other modules
  • Gutter icons: service interface / implementation class ↔ <service-point>
  • Java: registry.getService("app.Mailer", …); Tapestry 4: @InjectObject("service:…") and <inject object="service:…"/>
